purpose: The Payment Gateway enables merchants to accept card payments and provides a flexible foundation for the next three years of growth in the EU and UK.

components.name: Payments Edge Gateway
components.evidence: The Payments Edge Gateway is the single front door for all merchant calls and keeps the experience simple and fast for the merchant.

components.name: payments-core
components.evidence: payments-core calls the Acquirer connector, which translates the request for the acquirer of the merchant, and stores the result in payments-db.

components.name: Acquirer connector
components.evidence: payments-core calls the Acquirer connector, which translates the request for the acquirer of the merchant, and stores the result in payments-db.

components.name: payments-db
components.evidence: payments-db holds payments, refunds and the history of status changes.

flows.evidence: A merchant backend calls the Payments Edge Gateway with the payment request.
The Payments Edge Gateway forwards the request to payments-core, the engine that holds the lifecycle of a payment.
payments-core calls the Acquirer connector, which translates the request for the acquirer of the merchant, and stores the result in payments-db.
